I will apply some inorganic fertilizer because the government sometimes makes it available at subsidized prices through the agro-dealers, but I can only afford a small amount for my 0.14 hectare plot. I use my own saved maize seed because improved varieties are too costly and I do not trust them to do better than what my father taught me to plant. I will not spray chemicals for pests or irrigate because I have no money for pumps, nozzles, or fuel, and the rains are what Allah provides. My family will do all the work ourselves since the plot is small and hiring labor would take away what little we hope to harvest.
